author: LARSSØNNERGÅRD

title: Lifesaver
body:
Hi there! I’m a 15 year old, with ADD (another form of ADHD) and autism.
I always get distracted and lose track of time, which results in me having stressful mornings, never fully finishing my routine, and being late all the time.

However, this app just works some magic, I don’t know how to explain it. Before I found the app, I could use 4 hours on my mourning routine, and still not finish.
Now I can do everything within an hour.
The way that you can make your OWN routine, and quickly rearrange the order or add another task if you have a different day, is absolutely amazing.
I use the free version, and I have no complaints.

To whoever made this app, THANK YOU so so MUCH! I don’t think you understand what change this made to my life❤️
author: emma09_sofie

title: Virker ikke
body:
Jeg har forsøgt at skabe rutiner og sætte notifikationer til, så de ville starte på et bestemt tidspunkt hver dag. Men ud af det blå bliver notifikationerne gjort lydløse.  
Og sætter man appen til at auto tale, virker det kun sporadisk. 
Herefter forsøgte jeg at få appel til at returnere mine penge fra købet af appen, men det kan så ikke lade sig gøre. Nu har jeg så et års abonnement på en app der ikke fungere. 

Pisse fedt!

title: Motivating, good luck and easy to use:)
body:
Hello Routinery 

Overall this is the best productive app i’ve ever had and its keeping me motivated, so that’s a thumps up, but there is one thing that irritates me a litte.

When you’re a making an habit, and pressing explore, then you get to a page with the headline ‘Routines’, and then you can choose eg ‘Morning routine’, and then habits comes up and you can choose if you wanna add the habit to your own habits, with pressing on the ‘+’.

Then there is a habit under the button that says ‘+ My Routine’, and it can’t be quite hard to add, when I press on the ‘+’. 

Can you guys fix that?

-Yours sincerely 
a happy user:)
